# Nymrel Open-Source Ecosystem Portal
> The Open Operating Layer for Autonomous AI Agents, Swarms & Modern Web

## Entity & Governance
- Primary Umbrella: Nymrel (https://nymrel.com)
- Parent Legal Entity: JalenBuilds LLC (https://nymrel.com)
- Founder: Jalen
- Contact: contact@nymrel.com
- Licenses: MIT and Apache-2.0 (100% Free & Open Source)
- Aesthetics: Nymrel Warm Paper (#FAF8F2, #F4F0E6, #2A332E, #A8541F, #E2DDD2)

## Catalog: 28 Public Repositories (synced 2026-08-23)

### Agents & Swarms

#### 1. Swarm Studio (@nymrel/swarm-studio)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-swarm-studio
- Description: Visual command deck for multi-agent coding swarms with Warm Paper aesthetics and A2UI streaming components.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-swarm-studio.git

#### 2. Local Forge (@nymrel/local-forge)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/local-agent-forge
- Description: Zero-cloud local GPU orchestrator, dynamic model router, and MCP server for agentic workflows.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/local-agent-forge.git

#### 3. BuilderWars (builderwars)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/builderwars
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com/builderwars
- Description: Same model. Your harness. A contest between harnesses with one-command replay verification.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/builderwars.git

#### 4. Crawler Mesh (@nymrel/crawler-mesh)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-crawler-mesh
- Description: Zero-telemetry, high-throughput web crawler and clean markdown extractor built for AI agents and LLMs.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-crawler-mesh.git

#### 5. Website Audit Plugin (@nymrel/website-audit-plugin)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-plugin
- Description: Nymrel universal plugin for ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and MCP hosts.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-plugin.git

#### 6. Agent Beacon (@nymrel/agent-beacon)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agent-beacon
- Description: Zero-dependency liveness sentinel, heartbeat monitor, and dead-man switch watchdog mesh for AI coding fleets.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/agent-beacon.git

#### 7. MCP Hub (@nymrel/mcp-hub)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-mcp-hub
- Description: Unified Model Context Protocol server aggregating Nymrel toolchains for Claude, Cursor, Codex, and OpenAI agents.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-mcp-hub.git

#### 8. Swarm Protocol (@nymrel/swarm-protocol)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-swarm-protocol
- Description: Universal multi-agent swarm protocol, two-seat command studio contract, and file-based bus engine.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-swarm-protocol.git

#### 9. Presence (presence-rail)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/presence
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com/presence
- Description: An agent hits a step that needs a human. Presence pauses it, buzzes a phone, and resumes once the person has acted.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/presence.git

### Commerce & Micropayments

#### 10. OpenUCP (@nymrel/open-ucp)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/open-ucp
- Description: Zero-dependency Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) & Agentic Purchasing Engine with x402 micropayments.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/open-ucp.git

#### 11. UCP Scanner (agentic-ucp-scanner)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agentic-ucp-scanner
- Description: Zero-dependency CLI & audit engine to verify websites for AI Agent Commerce Readiness and JSON-LD trust.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/agentic-ucp-scanner.git

#### 12. Headless Quote Layer (@nymrel/headless-quote)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/headless-quote-layer
- Description: Zero-dependency visual quote calculator, dynamic range estimator, and lead capture engine.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/headless-quote-layer.git

### Security & Sandboxing

#### 13. Agent Sandstorm (@nymrel/agent-sandstorm)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agent-sandstorm
- Description: Zero-Trust Agent Execution Sandbox & Copy-on-Write Workspace Isolation Engine with instant rollback.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/agent-sandstorm.git

#### 14. Agent Surety (agent-action-surety)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agent-action-surety
- Description: Deny-by-default execution safety envelope and cryptographic SHA-256 Merkle ledger for AI coding swarms.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/agent-action-surety.git

#### 15. Proof Ledger (@nymrel/proof-ledger)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-proof-ledger
- Description: Zero-dependency dual-language cryptographic attestation and proof-of-execution protocol library.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-proof-ledger.git

#### 16. PermitMesh (PermitMesh)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/PermitMesh
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com
- Description: A portable policy-decision profile for AI agents changing software. PDP, not PEP.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/PermitMesh.git

#### 17. Agent Proofchain (agent-proofchain)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agent-proofchain
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com
- Description: Provider-neutral admission decisions and tamper-evident action receipts for AI agents.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/agent-proofchain.git

### UI & Machine Trust

#### 18. A2UI Warm Paper (a2ui-warm-paper)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/a2ui-warm-paper
- Description: Google A2UI (Agent-to-UI) declarative JSON specification component system in Nymrel Warm Paper aesthetics.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/a2ui-warm-paper.git

#### 19. Machine Trust (@nymrel/machine-trust)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust
- Description: Dual-Audience Machine Trust & AI Search Discoverability Engine for modern web applications.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust.git

#### 20. Trust Scorecard (@nymrel/trust-scorecard)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-trust-scorecard
- Description: AI readiness and machine trust scorecard web application in Nymrel Warm Paper design.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-trust-scorecard.git

#### 21. AI Visibility Scorecard (ai-visibility-scorecard)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/ai-visibility-scorecard
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com/tools/ai-visibility-scorecard
- Description: Grade how findable your site is to ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity, with fixes ranked by impact.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/ai-visibility-scorecard.git

#### 22. ChatGPT Recommends (chatgpt-recommends)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/chatgpt-recommends
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com/tools/chatgpt-recommends
- Description: Check whether ChatGPT recommends your business: three buyer-intent prompts, paste the answers, get a scored verdict.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/chatgpt-recommends.git

#### 23. JSON-LD Generator (json-ld-generator)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/json-ld-generator
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com/tools/json-ld-generator
- Description: Generate schema.org JSON-LD for LocalBusiness, Product, FAQ and more, or check markup you already have.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/json-ld-generator.git

#### 24. llms.txt Generator (llms-txt-generator)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/llms-txt-generator
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com/tools/llms-txt-generator
- Description: Build a publish-ready llms.txt — a short map of your site that AI assistants can read in one pass.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/llms-txt-generator.git

### Developer Tools

#### 25. Noop Flags (noop-flags)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/noop-flags
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com
- Description: Find the CLI flags your program accepts and never reads. One file, no dependencies.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/noop-flags.git

#### 26. Token Spend Dashboard (token-spend-dashboard)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/token-spend-dashboard
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com/tools/token-spend-dashboard
- Description: Paste an Anthropic or OpenAI usage export and get a spend dashboard by day and model. Nothing leaves your device.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/token-spend-dashboard.git

#### 27. QR UTM Generator (qr-utm-generator)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/qr-utm-generator
- Homepage: https://nymrel.com/tools/qr-utm-generator
- Description: QR codes with UTM tracking built into the link, so you know which flyer brought them in.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/qr-utm-generator.git

#### 28. Ecosystem Portal (@nymrel/portal)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-ecosystem-portal
- Description: This portal: the official open-source showcase, documentation hub, and interactive catalog for the Nymrel agent suite.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-ecosystem-portal.git
